entity_note: STACKIT is the cloud brand inside Schwarz Digits, the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group. Neither STACKIT nor Schwarz Digits publishes a revenue figure for STACKIT alone, in any year.

parent.name: Schwarz Group (Unternehmen der Schwarz Gruppe)
parent.relationship: STACKIT sits inside Schwarz Digits, one of the group's business fields alongside Lidl, Kaufland and PreZero. The Schwarz Group is privately held and publishes turnover in an annual press release rather than a filed annual report.

fiscal_year_note: Schwarz Group fiscal year 2025 means 1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026. The years in this file are the group's own fiscal-year labels and run roughly two months ahead of the calendar year.

status_vocabulary.reported: figure published by the entity itself
status_vocabulary.undisclosed: the entity does not publish this figure
status_vocabulary.not_located: published at the time but not found in an accessible source in this pass
status_vocabulary.not_applicable: the entity or reporting unit did not exist in this period
status_vocabulary.not_yet_reported: period not closed, or results not yet published as at the compile date
status_vocabulary.rounded: the only company statement gives the figure rounded

proxy.label: Schwarz Digits division
proxy.explanation: The division contains STACKIT together with XM Cyber, Schwarz Digital and the group's internal IT. STACKIT is one part of it, so STACKIT must be smaller than this figure. How much smaller is not published.
proxy.in_plain_words: the cloud arm is inside this figure, so it is smaller

europe.note: The Schwarz Group publishes a single worldwide turnover figure and no geographic breakdown of any kind. Lidl and Kaufland store counts are given by country, but no revenue is.

sources.covers: FY2025, balance-sheet date 28 February 2026; Schwarz Digits 2.2 billion

notes: STACKIT revenue is undisclosed for every year since the platform opened to external customers in 2022. Before that the cloud arm did not exist as an external business, which is recorded as not_applicable rather than undisclosed.

Schwarz Digits was founded in September 2023 and first reported for fiscal year 2023. Its revenue is carried as division context, not as STACKIT revenue: the division also contains XM Cyber, Schwarz Digital and the group's internal IT.

Schwarz Group turnover for fiscal years 2015 to 2017 was published in press releases at the time but was not found in an accessible Schwarz source in this pass. It is marked not_located, which is different from undisclosed.
The group is privately held and files no consolidated annual report. Every figure here comes from the group's own annual turnover press release or its sustainability report.
Fiscal year 2026 ends on 28 February 2027, well after the compile date.
